dataset.title: SHU Dataset
dataset.paper_title: A large EEG dataset for studying cross-session variability in motor imagery brain-computer interface

verified_from_primary_paper.task: left-hand versus right-hand grasping motor imagery
verified_from_primary_paper.preprocessing: Bad segments/trials removed; baseline removed; 0.5-40 Hz FIR band-pass filtering applied before release; some sessions therefore contain fewer than 100 trials.
verified_from_primary_paper.processed_representation: Preprocessed continuous/session data in EDF with TSV event information, organized using EEG-BIDS conventions.
verified_from_primary_paper.trial_representation: One MAT file per subject/session; variables data [trials, 32, 1000] and labels [1=left, 2=right].
verified_from_primary_paper.consent_ethics: Signed experimental consent; Shanghai Second Rehabilitation Hospital Ethics Committee approval ECSHSRH 2018-0101.

representation_selection.acquire_when_unblocked: Only the Figshare archive/file that contains the per-subject, per-session MAT trial data.
exclude_as_duplicate: EDF/TSV processed representation of the same released signals
representation_selection.rationale: The MAT representation is already trial-aligned and labeled for chronological within-subject and cross-session MI evaluation, avoiding storage and accounting duplication with the EDF release.

rights.caution: The CC BY 4.0 statement on the Nature article is an article license and was not treated as the Figshare dataset license. The paper calls the dataset open access/free to download, but that wording is not a reusable-data license grant.

public_file_metadata.known_version_basis: Versioned DOI cited by the primary paper; not a current-version API response.

access_attempts.result: The retrieval service could not access the DOI target or canonical Figshare record page. Search results exposed the primary paper only, not the dataset manifest.
HTTP 403 from this host; the same read-only request from the CUDA workstation also returned HTTP 403. No file endpoint was called.

decision.reason: Dataset rights and exact public file metadata could not be verified through two reasonable official-source paths.
decision.resume_condition: Retrieve a successful official Figshare record/API response showing dataset license plus the selected MAT archive's file ID, filename, byte size, MD5, version and direct download URL.
decision.recommended_next_action: Do not acquire payload yet. When Figshare access works, select only the MAT trial-data archive and compute/verify its total against the official byte count before downloading.

sources.role: Primary paper and canonical dataset citation; study design, preprocessing, representations, consent and ethics.
